profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
My name is Kerry Smith. I am a Full Stack Web Developer with interests in front-end JavaScript libraries and UI design. When we can visualize data, the design develops intuitively and most importantly, it develops naturally. To see the front and back-end come together bit by bit is truly rewarding.


Front-end technologies:  HTML | CSS | JavaScript | React | Git | Next.js  
			                Responsive Design | Testing/Debugging
Back-end technologies:  Node | Express | BaaS
Database technologies:  MongoDB | My SQL | Firebase | Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer | Software Engineer | MongoDB | Express | React | Node |
Full Stack Web Development Coding Bootcamp -MERN-
positions.description:
React-Colors app | https://github.com/Kerry-Jr/colors-app | https://the-colors-app.herokuapp.com/
Application that allows you to make and store material-UI react color palettes.
•	Solo project; completing all phases of the development life cycle, focusing on coding, testing, and debugging.
•	Documenting application changes and developing updates.
•	Identify best practices for architecture, performance, and accessibility.
•	HTML5, CSS3, Material-UI, JavaScript, React, Next.js, copy-to-clipboard, React-router, HOC, chroma.js, and deployed with Heroku. 

Blog Site | https://github.com/Kerry-Jr/Project02 | https://project02blog.herokuapp.com/
Blogging application made with a group. 
•	Front-end technologies and user-interface design.
•	Project lead in a group of four.
•	Develop and design reusable React.js components
•	Knowledge of effective UI / UX strategies and techniques.
•	HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, React, Redux, moment.js and MySQL

Plan-it | https://github.com/Kerry-Jr/Planet | https://blooming-atoll-78659.herokuapp.com/
Web application demonstrating authentication strategies.
•	Built in message boards for communication and user dashboard to edit profiles.
•	Responsible for development of responsive, web-based user interface.
•	Focused on the user-interface, the 2- way communication message boards and implemented the JWT authentication strategy for the app.
•	Delivering front-end code to backend development teams.
•	Web application integration with RestFul API.
•	HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, React, Redux, passport.js, moment.js, and MongoDB

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Built and maintained workstations, networks, and server infrastructure for more than 2 dozen produce companies in the bay area.
Test online ordering apps for each customer.
Deployed our software solution from beginning to end for new customers. Setup in house servers, cloud servers, and website hosting for online ordering.

Key Accomplishments:
•	Lead software implementation specialist.
•	Project manager and head of online ordering testing.
•	Successfully added more clients to a subscription-based model over traditional one-time payment. 
•	Developed 3rd party tool for QuickBooks Desktop software.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Law enforcement , Criminal Justice/Law Enforcement Administration

projects.title: React materials-ui colors application
projects.description: A react application that allows users to see color swatches made by material-UI from all over the globe. Plus users may create their own palettes and save them.  You can create, read, update, and delete to your choosing. Built in validations and fully responsive.

projects.title: CRWN clothing ltd
projects.description: React application that simulates a e-commerce clothing store. Users may sign in / up with google Oauth or their email address and password. Add items to cart, and checkout with stripe. Dummy credit card supplied in checkout page. Built this app from Udemy Complete React Developer in 2020 (w/ Redux, Hooks, GraphQL) by Andre Neagoie, and Yihua Zhang.
